scenes.title: Know what your money is doing.
scenes.say: fire doesn't just add up your money. It tells you what to look at next.

scenes.title: Portfolio insights
scenes.say: Insight tiles flag equity concentration, a single stock that's too big a slice, a missing asset class, and a CD that's about to mature.

scenes.title: Drill into any slice.
bullets: Click to see what's behind it
scenes.say: Click any slice of your allocation to see exactly which accounts and positions sit behind it.

scenes.title: Rebalance in one click.
scenes.say: Set a target mix, and the rebalancing tool lists the buys and sells that get you there.

scenes.title: Harvest your losses.
scenes.say: Tax-loss harvesting alerts find positions trading below what you paid, estimate the tax you could save, and count down to year end.

scenes.title: Where the money goes.
scenes.say: Cash flow shows your monthly surplus and savings rate, the number that moves your retire date most.

scenes.title: Budget and tax drag.
scenes.say: Your budget sets your FIRE number, card statements are categorized automatically, and the tax estimator shows how much of your spending is really tax.

scenes.title: Or just ask.
scenes.prompt: am I too concentrated in anything?
scenes.after: **VTI** is {risk.0.percentage}% of everything you own. Worth diversifying new money.
scenes.say: Or just ask Claude, and it checks your concentration risk with the real numbers.

scenes.title: Know what to fix next.
